Align-Anything

dataset.align-anything

Prepared 10 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 10 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-10.prelaunch.1

Evidence & scope

Creator-maintained documentation received separate bounded AI source-content reviews of construction, human/model roles, formats, licensing/access statements and limitations. Exact source revisions remain bound to every observation. Per-role full/partial/unread scopes differ and are recorded separately. This is no corpus download/recount, verification of every data file, model evaluation or assurance that another release shares these properties.
